content.short: MemeTok is a scroll-to-trade mobile app where social content doubles as the trading signal.
content.description: MemeTok merges token discovery with execution in one feed, so a trader who spots momentum in a piece of content can buy without leaving it. The usual path of noticing a coin, finding the launchpad, searching the contract and hitting buy is where the move is often missed. The app collapses that into scrolling, spotting and trading in the same place.
content.meta: A scrolling feed where the content is the pitch and trading happens inline.
